english translation text: YOU ARE THE SON OF ALI

arabic text: BETA HAI TU ALI KA, ZAHRA KI TU DUA HAI SHABBIR TERA AAKA, UMMUL BANEEN MAA HAI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE SON OF ALI, ANSWER TO ZAHRA’S PRAYERS\nSHABBIR IS YOUR MASTER, YOUR MOTHER IS UMMUL BANEEN

arabic text: HAR SURATO CHALAN MAI HAIDER SE NA JUDA HAI TA HASHR TUJ SE KAAYAM DUNYA MAIN BAS WAFA HAI
english translation text: YOU RESEMBLE ALI IN YOUR LOOKS AND PERSONALITY\nTILL THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT, LOYALTY EXISTS BECAUSE OF YOU

arabic text: TERE ALAM KO THAAME, HAR SHAKS KEH RAHA HAI MAZLOOME KERBALA KA, ZAINAB KA WAASTA HAI
english translation text: HOLDING ON TO YOUR BANNER, EVERY PERSON PLEADS FOR THE SAKE OF IMAM HUSAYN AND BIBI ZAINAB

arabic text: PARDESI KOYI AYSA, PARDES ME NA UJDE SADKE MEI USKE JIS KA, GHAR BAAR LUTGAYA HAI
english translation text: MAY NO TRAVELLER EVER SUFFER THE WAY YOU SUFFERED FOR THE SAKE OF THOSE WHO LOST EVERYTHING IN THE DESERT

arabic text: US WAKT JABKE ZAINAB, DARBAAR MEI GAYI THI QARI NAMAZIO SEY, MEHFIL SAJI HUWI THI
english translation text: THAT TRAUMATIC TIME WHEN ZAINAB WAS TAKEN TO COURT\nWHICH WAS FULL OF QURAN RECITORS AND WORSHIPPERS

arabic text: ZAALIM YEH PUCHTA THA, GHAZI TERA KAHA HAI BAALO SE MUH CHUPAAYE, ZAINAB YEH KEH RAHI THI
english translation text: THE OPPRESSORS WERE TAUNTING WHERE IS YOUR ABBAS? ZAINAB COVERED HER FACE WITH HER HAIR AND CRIED

arabic text: TAQDEER KE SATAYE, TERE DAR PE SAR JHUKAYE ASHKO KI ILTIJA HAM, GHAAZI TUJE SUNAYE
english translation text: SUFFERING FROM BAD LUCK, WE BOW OUR HEADS ON YOUR DOORSTEP TEARFULLY WE IMPLORE YOU, PLEASE LISTEN TO OUR WOES

arabic text: BEEMARE SAARIBAAN KE, ZAKHMO KA WAASTA HAI JITNE BHI KHASTA DIL HAI, MOWLA SHIFA WO PAAYE
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF SUFFERING AND INJURIES OF IMAM SAJJAD PLEASE CURE ALL THE SUFFERINGS AND ILLNESSES

arabic text: DIL KI MURAAD GAZI, TERE ALAM SE PAAEY ROTI HUWI JO MAAEN, TERE ALAM PE AAEY
english translation text: WE WILL GET OUR HEARTS DESIRES BY THE SAKE OF YOUR BANNER THOSE HEARTBROKEN MOTHERS THAT COME TO YOUR BANNER

arabic text: ZAHRA KE DARD PEHLU KA, DETI HAI WAASTA FIZZA KI KANEEZI MEI, MERA BHI NAAM AAEY
english translation text: THEY ASK YOU FOR THE SAKE OF ZAHRA’S BROKEN RIBS PLEASE ACCEPT US AS MAIDS OF BIBI FIZZA

arabic text: SHAAME GHARIBAN MEI JIS, KA KURTA JALGAYA HAI, KAANO SE BAALIYA BHI, HAAYE SHIMR LEGAYA HAI
english translation text: ON SHAME GARIBAAN WHOSE ABA GOT BURNT\nAND SHIMR SNATCHED THE EARINGS

arabic text: IS BEBASI SE MAWLA, BACCHI KOI NA TARSE FARSH-E-AZA PE ROKAR, HAR DIL YEH KEHRAHA HAI
english translation text: MAY NO LITTLE GIRL SUFFER IN THAT WAY ON THIS FLOOR OF MAJLIS EVERY HEART CRIES AND SAYS

arabic text: JITNE BHI ASHK MAULA, QIRTAAS PAR GIRE HAI MASUMA KI KASAM HI, GHAZI FAKAT TERE HAI
english translation text: MAULA WHATEVER TEARS HAVE FALLEN ON PAPER BY BIBI SAKINA, THEY ALL BELONG TO YOU

arabic text: WO KUCH RAKAM KARU MEI, JO NAA RAKAM HUWA HAI ALFAAZ WO ATAA KAR, 'YAWAR' SE JO PARE HAI
english translation text: MAKE ME WRITE THAT WHICH HAS NOT BEEN WRITTEN BEFORE GIVE ME THE GIFT OF WORDS THAT YAWAR CAN READ
